title: Shelter registration form
description: An exercise registration form for a shelter resident: household size, contact, supports and needs the household chooses to share, pets, and consent notes. It uses an exercise reference, never a real name or address, and says the resident decides what to share. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

needsShared.description: Supports the household asked for, in plain words

pets.description: Pets and service animals with the household

medications.description: Medicines or supplies they will need, generic terms
examples: Daily medication that needs a refrigerator

notes.description: Registration notes: language, mobility, anything else the household shared

consent.description: The statement that sharing is voluntary and kept to what the shelter needs
examples: The household decides what to share. Information is used only to run the shelter.
